mapper.select: SELECT j.scope_json FROM afv_canvas_agent_node_job j JOIN afv_canvas_node_run n ON n.id=j.node_run_id WHERE n.parent_node_run_id=#{parent} AND (n.attempt<#{attempt} OR (n.attempt=#{attempt} AND n.item_index<#{itemIndex})) AND n.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','BLOCKED','CANCELLED') ORDER BY n.item_index,n.attempt
SELECT scope_json FROM afv_canvas_agent_node_job WHERE node_run_id=#{nodeRunId} AND cancel_requested=FALSE FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.run_id FROM afv_agent_run r JOIN afv_agent_run p ON p.run_id=r.parent_run_id JOIN afv_canvas_agent_node_job j ON j.node_run_id=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.canvas_scope_json,'$.nodeRunId')) WHERE r.status='RUNNING' AND r.next_sequence=1 AND r.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND r.deadline_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (r.owner_instance_id=#{instance} OR r.lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND j.cancel_requested=FALSE AND p.status IN ('RUNNING','WAITING_EXTERNAL','WAITING_CONFIRMATION') AND p.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND p.deadline_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_agent_model_call_usage u WHERE u.run_id=r.run_id) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 32
SELECT * FROM afv_canvas_agent_node_job WHERE node_run_id = #{nodeRunId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT j.node_run_id FROM afv_canvas_agent_node_job j JOIN afv_agent_run r ON r.run_id=j.agent_run_id WHERE j.dispatch_state IN ('QUEUED','DISPATCHING') AND r.status='RUNNING' AND (r.owner_instance_id=#{instance} OR r.lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND r.deadline_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY j.created_at LIMIT 16
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_canvas_agent_node_job j JOIN afv_agent_run r ON r.run_id=j.agent_run_id SET j.dispatch_state='DISPATCHED',j.updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE j.node_run_id=#{nodeRunId} AND r.owner_epoch=#{epoch}
mapper.select: SELECT run_id FROM afv_agent_run WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(canvas_scope_json,'$.nodeRunId'))=#{nodeRunId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 65

SELECT m.id FROM afv_agent_model_request m JOIN afv_agent_run r ON r.run_id=m.run_id WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.canvas_scope_json,'$.nodeRunId'))=#{nodeRunId} AND m.permit_held=TRUE AND (m.status='UNKNOWN_SUBMISSION' OR r.status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) ORDER BY m.created_at,m.id
SELECT status FROM afv_agent_run WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(canvas_scope_json,'$.nodeRunId'))=#{nodeRunId} AND run_id<>#{runId}

SELECT j.agent_run_id FROM afv_canvas_agent_node_job j JOIN afv_agent_run r ON r.run_id=j.agent_run_id WHERE j.agent_run_id=#{id} AND j.node_run_id=#{nodeRunId} AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_agent_run c WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.canvas_scope_json,'$.nodeRunId'))=j.node_run_id AND c.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_generation_submission s JOIN afv_remote_generation_job g ON g.submission_id=s.id WHERE s.canvas_node_run_id=j.node_run_id AND (g.permit_held=TRUE OR g.state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','CANCELLED'))) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM afv_agent_model_request m JOIN afv_agent_run c ON c.run_id=m.run_id WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.canvas_scope_json,'$.nodeRunId'))=j.node_run_id AND m.permit_held=TRUE)
